editorial:
Set in the rough Brownsville section of Brooklyn, this crime drama follows three NYPD officers whose lives slowly crash into each other. Eddie is a burned-out veteran one week from retirement who is barely holding it together. Sal is a narcotics cop desperate for cash to support his growing family, and he starts crossing lines he never thought he would. Tango is an undercover officer who has gotten too close to the drug dealer he is supposed to bring down. The movie pulls you into their separate worlds and shows how the job can eat away at a person. It feels gritty and real, with a heavy mood that never lets up.

The acting is the real draw. Richard Gere, Ethan Hawke, and Don Cheadle all deliver strong, believable performances that carry the movie even when the story gets crowded. The action scenes are tense and well shot, and the pacing keeps you invested. On the downside, the plot can feel overstuffed, and some characters do not get enough screen time. Still, if you enjoy dark crime dramas with moral gray areas, this one is worth your time. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture.
endingExplained: In the final act, all three officers end up at the same housing project during a drug raid. Sal tries to steal drug money and gets caught in a shootout, where he is killed. Tango is forced to shoot and kill Caz, the dealer he had grown close to, to protect his cover. Eddie survives the chaos and walks away from the job for good, finally free of the badge. The ending shows that none of them truly win, and the line between cop and criminal was never as clear as it seemed.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves dark crime dramas with moral gray areas.
